results.name: Finset.gcd_dvd
results.source_text:
theorem gcd_dvd {b : β} (hb : b ∈ s) : s.gcd f ∣ f b :=
  dvd_gcd_iff.1 dvd_rfl _ hb

results.name: Finset.gcd_eq_gcd_image
results.source_text:
theorem gcd_eq_gcd_image [DecidableEq α] : s.gcd f = (s.image f).gcd id :=
  Eq.symm <| gcd_image _

results.name: Finset.gcd_image
results.source_text:
theorem gcd_image [DecidableEq β] {g : γ → β} (s : Finset γ) :
    (s.image g).gcd f = s.gcd (f ∘ g) := by
  classical induction s using Finset.induction <;> simp [*]

results.name: Finset.dvd_gcd_iff
results.source_text:
theorem dvd_gcd_iff {a : α} : a ∣ s.gcd f ↔ ∀ b ∈ s, a ∣ f b := by
  apply Iff.trans Multiset.dvd_gcd
  simp only [Multiset.mem_map, and_imp, exists_imp]
  exact ⟨fun k b hb ↦ k _ _ hb rfl, fun k a' b hb h ↦ h ▸ k _ hb⟩

results.name: Physlib.PiTensorProduct.instAddCommMonoidElim_physlib
results.source_text:
/-- Given two maps `s1` and `s2` whose targets carry an instance of an additive commutative
  monoid, the target of the sum of these two maps also carry an instance thereof. -/
instance : (i : ι1 ⊕ ι2) → AddCommMonoid ((fun i => Sum.elim s1 s2 i) i) := fun i =>
  match i with
  | Sum.inl i => inst1 i
  | Sum.inr i => inst2 i
results.docstring:
Given two maps `s1` and `s2` whose targets carry an instance of an additive commutative
